[P1] Publish skipped results only after the parallel checkpoint succeeds

`settleForParallelSnapshot()` calls this before `ParallelOperation.handleCompletion()` serializes or submits its `SUCCEED` checkpoint. A caller waiting in `branch.get()` can therefore catch the skip and checkpoint subsequent work before persisted state records that skip. If the invocation is interrupted in this window, replay sees an incomplete parent and can execute and complete the previously skipped branch, changing control flow against those subsequent checkpoints. Reserve the skip under the lock, but delay both future completion and the exception exposed by `get()` until the parent checkpoint succeeds. Add an interruption/replay test covering this window.
